Stop.command: if command -v afplay >/dev/null 2>&1; then (afplay -v 1.0 /System/Library/Sounds/Glass.aiff >/dev/null 2>&1 &) ; else tput bel >/dev/tty; fi; echo '{}'

LINT_ENFORCER_SKIP_DIRS='' bash ./lint-enforcer/lint-enforcer.sh # SKIP_DIRS = colon list of repos to never lint, e.g. '~/Develop/git/investment-ai-new:~/Develop/git/agentic-mod-dotnet' (upstream agent-harness skips these two: autofix broke their hash-checked files). Leading ~ = $HOME; subdirs are skipped too, name-prefix siblings are not. Reload hooks after editing.
